World Country Polygons - Very High Definition

description: World Bank Official Boundaries is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Agriculture", published or maintained by World Bank Group. World Bank-approved administrative boundaries (Admin 0) (and polygons) including international boundaries, disputed areas, coastlines, lakes and a guide to help with their usage. Boundaries are available as an ESRI GeoDatabase, in GeoJSON, a shapefile and API endpoints for interactive maps. Coverage: the whole world. It has 3 files in HTML, ZIP, VECTOR API. The portal files it under Agriculture. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
